n = int(input())
k = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007
MAX = 33

class Mat:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mat = [[0]*(MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]

def mat_mult(m1, m2, size):
    res = Mat()
    for i in range(size+1):
        for j in range(size+1):
            s = 0
            for p in range(size+1):
                s += m1.mat[i][p] * m2.mat[p][j]
            res.mat[i][j] = s % MOD
    return res
